dedupe_keys.name: probabilistic data generating process based crop type maps for the eu 1990 2018 and 2010 2020 1 km

description: These two Zenodo datasets give probabilistic crop type maps for the EU-28 at 1 km (EPSG:3035): one for 2010 to 2020 distinguishing 28 crop types, and one for 1990 to 2018 (Croatia from 1995) distinguishing 25 crop types, including expected crop shares per cell. The records say the maps come from the Data Generating Process-based procedure of Baumert, Heckelei and Storm (2024, Ecological Informatics), with a data article for the longer series, and that the code and input list are on GitHub. They were published on 20 September and 19 December 2024 by Josef Baumert, Thomas Heckelei and Hugo Storm as one ZIP per country (from about 1 MB for Malta to 6.6 GB for France), downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with EU-wide coverage. Caveats: each cell gives probabilities, not a single crop, and the maps rest on CORINE land cover and regional statistics, so field detail is not captured. For simulation they give crop mixes with uncertainty for drought, flood and heat exposure of European agriculture, and long histories for crop demand and supply scenarios. Related catalogue records include the JRC EUCROPMAP and the EU Farm Sustainability Data Network.
